reason: The durable Lane C shard currently provides aggregate project deployment counts and project IDs, but not the per-deployment deploymentId values required to form stable projectId:deploymentId identities and apply PANTAVION_CANONICAL_SHARDING_V1 deterministically.
requiredEvidenceToResume: A durable payload-backed Lane C evidence file containing each deploymentId and its immutable source provenance.
The evidence must be sufficient to compute stableRecordKey=projectId:deploymentId and SHA-256 bucket ownership without inference.
safetyRulesApplied: Do not materialize aggregate counts as physical records.
Do not guess deployment IDs or bucket ownership.
Do not treat READY/production historical metadata as VERIFIED_LIVE.
When payload-backed evidence appears, canonicalize only buckets 5-9 and merge by stable identity idempotently.
